may-generate-new.meaning: Generator may create new original media. assetRef must be generated:<id> or placeholder:<id>.

placeholder-only.meaning: No real asset and no generated likeness. assetRef must be placeholder:<id>.

must-not-reproduce.meaning: Real trademark or proprietary brand media: never reused, traced, recreated or imitated. assetRef must be placeholder:<id>.

omit.meaning: The field must be absent from generated PageSpecs entirely.

licensingNote: Source is the live site of a real company (The Equator Company, equatorcompany.com). Real people's names/photos, partner/merger/member logos, client project slides, brand Lotties/videos, the PRR PDF and the National 2 font are not licensed for reuse in generated output.

brand-wordmark.description: The Equator Company wordmark (header 352x34, footer stacked 276x180). Real trademark.

ambient-video.description: Ambient looping background video slot (title: screen blend over coral; CTA: under oat multiply). New original footage may be generated; the brand's bird_low.mp4 / cloud_low.mp4 must never be reused.

merger-logo.description: Logos of the four real merged companies in the story section. Real third-party trademarks.

member-logo.description: 'Proud member of' marquee logos (logo1-9.png). Real third-party trademarks.

project-photo.description: Our Work slide photography. New imagery may be generated provided it depicts no identifiable real person, client, brand or site; the real client project photos (slides/slide1-5) must never be reused.

team-portrait.description: Real employees' portraits (15 people). Never reuse, never generate a likeness: neutral placeholder only.

team-halftone.description: Halftone 'back' images derived from the real employees' portraits. Still a likeness: placeholder only.

funding-emblem.description: PRR / Republica Portuguesa / EU funding strip (mono.svg). Reproducing it would falsely claim public funding: the field must be absent.

project-sheet-pdf.description: The company's PRR project sheet PDF. Real proprietary document: never linked or bundled; the field must be absent.

font.national-2.description: National 2 (Klim Type Foundry), weights 400/500. Not an assetRole: never referenced from a PageSpec; generated output uses the token fallback stack unless the deployer holds a licence.
